messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to know exactly how many suitcases I’m allowed to bring on my upcoming flight. I have a lot to pack, so I really need the correct number. Can you help me with that?

I can help you with that. To provide the exact number of suitcases you are allowed to bring on your upcoming flight, I need to know your user ID and the reservation ID for the flight. Could you please provide those details?

Sure, my user ID is anya_garcia_5901 and my confirmation number is JMO1MG. Can you please tell me the total number of suitcases I can take? I really need the number in digits, not just words, since it’s easier for me to see it that way.

For your upcoming flight in economy class, as a user with your membership level (not explicitly stated but assumed regular if not otherwise), you are allowed 1 free checked bag per passenger. Since you have 2 passengers on this reservation, you are allowed a total of 2 free checked bags. If you want to bring more than that, additional bags will incur a fee. 

Please let me know if you want to add more checked bags or if you need any other assistance.

Thank you, but I’m pretty sure I’m a Gold member. Can you please double-check and confirm the total number of suitcases I can bring? And again, I really need the answer in numbers, not just words. It’s really important to me that this is correct.

You are a Silver member. For Silver members flying in economy class, the allowance is 2 free checked bags per passenger. Since you have 2 passengers, you can bring a total of 4 free checked bags.

If you want to bring more than 4 bags, additional bags will incur a fee. Let me know if you want to add more checked bags or if you need further assistance.
I’m sorry, but I’m pretty sure I’m a Gold member, not Silver. Can you please transfer me to a supervisor so I can get this sorted out? This is really important to me.
